The '''Special Operations office''' was a department of the [[Office of the Chief of State]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. The Special Operations office managed a [[Daala's special-missions force|special-missions force]] during the administration of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]].
